A classic Rookgaard quest: a warrior entered a cave, met monsters he could not beat, and his equipment was left where he died. Cross the {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms} cave beneath the graves in the northeast of the island and take a {item:Katana} and a {item:Viking Helmet} from the bodies. Along the way you pick up the {item:Key 4603}.
A Rookgaard warrior ventured into a cave, met monsters he could not defeat, and his loot is where he died.
Graves in the northeast of the island
or about 3 extra Small Health Potions to withstand the poison
Use the **defensive** stance in the Rotworm room to take minimal damage.
Kill the {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons} on the second floor before moving on: otherwise they follow you and can block your way back.
Go to the graves in the **northeast** of the island and open the **middle one, at the bottom** with the {item:Shovel}.
Graves (open the middle one, at the bottom)
The grave to open with the shovel
Go west and jump into the hole
Go down the hole. There may be {creature:Spider|Spiders} and {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}. Follow the path **west** to a hole and jump into it.
The path west to the hole
In this area there are {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}. Kill them all before moving on. A safe way: go to the **south** of the room and kill them one by one, standing in the narrow passage.
The Skeleton room and the narrow passage to the south
Go **east** until you find a rope spot. Get ready: the next room may demand time and care.

Use the {item:Rope} to go up into the {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms} room. There are many. The best thing is to **run** to the other hole and go down as fast as possible, without letting yourself get cornered. Use the defensive stance.
This room can be dangerous even for experienced Rookgaard players. Drink potions before your health gets low.
Cross the {item:Poison Field|poison fields} (there are 4). Use the {item:Antidote Potion|Antidote Potions} or heal with health potions afterwards.

If you do not have the {item:Key 4603} yet: from the poison fields turn **north**. The key is hidden in one of the corpses there. Use the defensive stance while you run from the Rotworms. When you find it, go back **south**.
If you already have Key 4603, skip this step.
From the poison fields, go **east** to a hole and go down. Down there is a single {creature:Skeleton} (kill it if you want). Open the door with the {item:Key 4603} and go down the stairs.
The door that opens with Key 4603

There is a lever hidden behind the **north white pillar**. Use it to unlock the treasure room door (if it is not already open). The best thing is to wait for the creatures to leave the room, run in and close the door. With friends, you can also kill them one by one at the door.
The lever behind the north white pillar
If the door is open, there may be **two Skeletons and a Rotworm** inside the room.
The treasure is inside the **fresh human corpses** in the room. Take the {item:Viking Helmet} and the {item:Katana} from there.
The treasure room with the corpses

Go back the same way to leave the cave: go up the stairs, pass the door and go up through the hole, cross the poison fields and the {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms} room again to the hole you came up by, go down to the {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons} area and head **west**. Use the {item:Rope} to climb the holes (the one at the door, the one you jumped into and the grave) until you are back at the graves in the northeast of the island.
If someone closes the door with the lever from the outside, use the room's teleport to get out.
